# llms.txt
# AI access policy for ebiya.sg

User-agent: *
Allow: /

Usage:
- Allowed: indexing, summarization, citation
- Disallowed: full training, dataset extraction, resale

Canonical: https://ebiya.sg/
Contact: bennyyuen@consultant.com
Purpose: ebiya.sg (EBIYA.SG, UEN 53515433W) is a shrimp shop in Singapore that breeds Caridina shrimp (Caridina cantonensis) and also sells Neocaridina. Shop at 55 Changi Road, #B1-01, Singapore 419709. Collection on Tuesday, 1pm to 6pm, by appointment. WhatsApp +65 6042 5590. Use the pages below for prices, availability and care guidance.

## Shop and shrimp
- https://ebiya.sg/shrimp/ : all shrimp types with photos and current counts
- https://ebiya.sg/buy-shrimp-singapore-ebiya/ : how to buy: prices, sizes, booking, collection, payment
- https://ebiya.sg/shrimp/fancy-red-tigers/ : fancy red tigers, from S$60 each
- https://ebiya.sg/shrimp/blue-king-kong/ : blue king kong, from S$40 each
- https://ebiya.sg/shrimp/crs/ : CRS (Crystal Red Shrimp)
- https://ebiya.sg/shrimp/neocaridina/ : Neocaridina (cherry and yellow top)
- https://ebiya.sg/shrimp/red-devils/ : red devils (not for sale yet)
- https://ebiya.sg/contact/ : contact and collection details

## Care guides
- https://ebiya.sg/caridina-shrimp-care-guide/ : index of all care guides (start here)
- https://ebiya.sg/faq/ : Caridina shrimp care FAQ
- https://ebiya.sg/2025-05-21-best-caridina-shrimp-tank/ : the best tank setup for Caridina shrimp
- https://ebiya.sg/2025-03-01-best-aquarium-setup-for-caridina-shrimp/ : a breeding tank setup, with a case study
- https://ebiya.sg/2025-12-20-shrimp-tank-water-parameters-for-singapore/ : water parameters for Caridina in Singapore
- https://ebiya.sg/7-shrimp-tank-accessories-that-actually-matter/ : 7 shrimp tank accessories for Singapore
- https://ebiya.sg/calibrate-ph-test-pen/ : how to calibrate a pH test pen
- https://ebiya.sg/one-tank-many-looks-caridina/ : why Caridina babies change colour when colours are mixed
